annotation.title_clean: Taking A Continental Leap Towards A Technologically Empowered Africa At The AUDA-NEPAD AI Dialogue
annotation.title_en: Taking A Continental Leap Towards A Technologically Empowered Africa At The AUDA-NEPAD AI Dialogue
annotation.summary_en: Blog post by AUDA-NEPAD reporting on its 29 February 2024 AI Dialogue, which presented the draft Continental AI White Paper and Roadmap, launched an African Youth in AI & Robotics Competition, and discussed AI, drones and robotics in education. It favours balancing innovation with regulation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Unveiled AI Continental White Paper and Roadmap, developed with the AU High-Level Panel on Emerging Technologies and 50+ experts
Roadmap has six pillars, including human capital, infrastructure and data, enabling environments, and monitoring and evaluation
Dialogue aims to promote responsible AI adoption that is ethical, transparent and accountable
African Youth in AI & Robotics Competition offers prizes of USD 2,000 to 5,000 across 10 categories
A panelist urged balancing regulation and innovation to avoid premature regulation
